name: Projectspaces
author: mehiel
description: Give every workspace a team: anything launched there starts in the team folder, with its mise env and browser profile. Per-monitor workspaces, saved windows, named workspaces in the bar, with a minimap of the active one's windows.

barWidget.description: This monitor's workspaces, named and tagged with their projectspace.

schema.label: Minimap
schema.description: Beside the active workspace, a box per window in layout order: the focused one in the accent color, ones scrolled off screen dimmed. Click a box to focus its window; hover it for its title.

schema.label: Minimap maximum width
schema.description: Longest the minimap may get, in logical pixels. Past it, it scrolls with the focused window and glows at the edge that hides more.

schema.label: Minimap: name on focus change
schema.description: Besides on hover, pop the window's name tab up for a moment whenever focus moves to a window on this workspace.

schema.label: Minimap: floating windows
schema.description: Include floating windows in the minimap.

schema.label: Minimap: reduce motion
schema.description: No bounce or swell, and alerts glow steadily instead of pulsing.
